svg.title: What is unknown, and what it blocks
svg.desc: Eight open questions on the left, and what each one is holding up on the right. The right-hand cards are the same cards as in the build plan and the findings, so clicking one moves to that thing rather than to a copy of it. An unknown with nothing on its right is not urgent; it is simply unanswered.
